capabilities: replace Obsidian's UI icons with custom SVG icons
export icon configurations to a file
import icon configurations, e.g. a Boxicons example set
extras: An example Boxicons configuration file (examples/boxicons.yml) is included in the repo for testing; icons must be supplied in SVG format.
problem: Obsidian's UI icons are fixed and users who want a different icon set have no built-in way to replace them.
summary: Icon replacement plugin that lets users swap Obsidian's default UI icons with custom SVG icons, with export and import of icon configurations.
